description:
These random shape otti tiles for outdoor floors are irregular concrete pieces from the Pak Clay catalogue, laid like crazy paving on garden paths, patios, terraces and porches.

## How they look
Each piece has its own outline, so the floor builds up as an informal mosaic of angled shapes with joints running in every direction. The random pattern tends to hide small differences between pieces and gives an outdoor floor a natural, stone-like character rather than a grid.

## Where they work
- **Garden paths and walkways** that wind between planting.
- **Patios, terraces and courtyards** that want an informal look.
- **Porches and house entrances**: tell us the use so we can advise.

Concrete otti tiles are a hard-wearing option for outdoor areas, and crazy paving tiles have long been used in Pakistani gardens because the layout copes well with curves and odd-shaped spaces.

## Good to know
- Material: concrete
- Pattern: random shapes (crazy paving)
- Type: otti / tuff tile
- Category: otti tiles
- Size, thickness and colour options: confirm on enquiry

Lay patio floor tiles on a firm, compacted base with a slight fall so rainwater drains away, and fill joints fully. For vehicle areas, confirm suitability with us first. Our guide to [otti tiles in Pakistan](/blog/otti-tiles-in-pakistan-what-they-are-and-where-they-work) explains where they work, and [outdoor floor tile options](/blog/outdoor-floor-tiles-in-pakistan-terracotta-otti-and-paver-options) compares them with terracotta and pavers.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the colour and surface, then send your area and city for a dated quote. For ramps, see the [random shapes ramp otti tiles](/products/random-shapes-ramp-otti-tiles), or browse all [otti tiles](/categories/otti-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of random shape otti tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the floor area, thickness, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are random shape otti tiles good for a porch?
faqs.a: They are often used on porches and entrances because the random joints hide wear. If cars will drive on the area, tell Pak Clay first so the team can advise on thickness and base.

faqs.q: Random shape otti or square pavers: which is better?
faqs.a: Random shapes give an informal, crazy-paving look and fit curves easily; square pavers give a neat grid and are quicker to set out. Choose by the look you want and the shape of the area.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Random Shapes Concrete Otti" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
